facts.business: GNG Electronics Limited is India's largest refurbisher of laptops and desktops and among the largest refurbishers of ICT devices globally, operating under the Electronics Bazaar brand with an integrated business model spanning sourcing, secure IT asset disposal, refurbishment, quality assurance, sales, warranty and after-sales support.
key_risks: Macro-economic conditions and industry growth: Performance is closely tied to growth trends in the global and Indian refurbished electronics industry, the pace of digitisation, and demand for affordable, sustainable technology.
Concentration in laptop sales: A substantial share of revenue is derived from the sale of laptops, making results sensitive to shifts in laptop demand.
Dependence on price-sensitive raw materials: A large share of costs relates to materials sourced both domestically and internationally, exposing margins to price and supply fluctuations.
Indebtedness and debt servicing: The business carries borrowings and associated debt servicing obligations that could constrain financial flexibility.
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company made a further investment of ` 100,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Hundred Crores Only) in Electronics Bazaar FZC (EB FZC) Subsidiary of Company through rights issue. The proceeds from the investment were utilized towards prepayment and/or repayment, in full or in part, of certain outstanding borrowings availed by EB FZC, as per the stated object in the Prospectus of the Company.
